title: Docs: correct attribution credit lines in merged research packages
body:
## Factual attribution corrections (docs-only)

These are factual attribution corrections from the completed attribution sweep of the 78 PR bodies authored by navinor in this repository. The sweep audited PR bodies only; every correction was gated and applied to the cited PRs' bodies. This PR applies the same corrections to the credit lines of merged research packages on main. Citation text only: no numbers, results, proofs or other prose changed.

### Corrections

1. `research/complex-queue-ceiling-uncovered/README.md` (from [PR 1648](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1648)): the "#1183/#1192/#1201/#1207/#1218 lineages" were credited to jeremykothe2; all five PRs are Rohan Arun's (rohanarun): [PR 1183](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1183) / [PR 1192](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1192) / [PR 1201](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1201) / [PR 1207](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1207) / [PR 1218](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1218).
2. `research/joint-dual-replay-fast/README.md` and `TASK.json` (from [PR 1880](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1880)): "Chafik Boukhalfa (PR25-PR58 lineage)" mapped the whole span to one author. The line runs from [PR 25](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/25) by Rohan Arun (rohanarun, with OpenAI Codex assistance) through [PR 58](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/58) by Chafik Boukhalfa (chafreaky, with OpenAI Codex assistance).
3. `research/masked-root-star-floor/README.md`, `NOTICE.md`, `CLAIM.md` (from [PR 1226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1226)): "woklerx (#968 and #1077)". [PR 968](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/968) (the eight-term all-pairs floor) is themilkman216's (with Anthropic Claude assistance); [PR 1077](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1077) (its complex extension) is woklerx's (with OpenAI Codex assistance).
4. `research/bit-ledger-frame-ranks-seedfeb2/README.md` and `TASK-CARD.md`, `research/selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic/README.md` (from [PR 2099](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2099)): "the PR589/PR555 lineage (eumemic and predecessors)" mapped the names positionally opposite to the PRs. [PR 589](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/589) is DreamingOfClouds's; [PR 555](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/555) is eumemic's. The corrected phrasing names each PR's author explicitly and keeps their credited predecessors.

Every cited PR's author was verified with `gh pr view NNN --json author,title` before naming.

### Scope note

Docs-only: no research package is created, and nothing is registered with `scripts/research_package.py` (this is a repo-docs change to merged packages' credit text). The only SOURCES pin that references a touched file is `research/joint-dual-replay-production/SOURCES.json` -> `research/joint-dual-replay-fast/README.md` with `usage: "provenance"`, which is not a drift-enforced `input` row; the one `input` pin into that package (`fast_replay.py`) is untouched.
